summary.name: Marta
summary.one_liner: Marta is a native macOS file manager written entirely in Swift, with keyboard-driven navigation, archive support, theming, and a Lua plugin API.
use_cases: browse and edit files inside zip, rar, 7z and tar archives
navigate files with the keyboard instead of the mouse
search system-wide for files using macOS indices
analyze which folders consume disk space
manage and pause ongoing file copy or move operations
customize keyboard shortcuts and layout with a DSL config
summary.what_it_does: Marta is a file manager for macOS written in Swift, described as fully native and fast. It lets users open and write ZIP archives and open formats such as RAR, 7Z, XAR, TAR, ISO, CAB and LZH, including viewing and editing files in nested archives. It supports keyboard and mouse use, a Actions Panel opened with Cmd+Shift+P, substring or regex quick search, and system-global file lookup powered by macOS indices. Other features include multiple windows and tabs, a hidden-file toggle, Finder-style Space preview, a task queue for file operations, disk usage analysis, and a built-in terminal synced to the pane directory. Configuration uses a DSL, themes are included with support for custom ones, and plugins are written against a Lua API.
notable: Written entirely in Swift as a native macOS app
Extensible through a Lua plugin API with online documentation
Opens and writes ZIP and reads many archive formats, including nested archives
Configurable through a streamlined DSL, with five bundled themes
caveats: Only macOS is named as a platform
Page text does not state pricing terms; the awesome-mac listing labels it Freeware
